name: kh-uaf
description: KH UAF provides an auditable front-door runtime, packaged workflow skills, development progress state, and role-based task command packets for Codex, Antigravity-style agents, Claude Code, and local workflows. The packaged always-on-front-door skill directly requests KH intake for every new conversation and user task but cannot guarantee host auto-selection; runtime receipts and session audits prove actual use.

interface.shortDescription: Personal UAF skillbook with auditable front-door intake.
interface.longDescription: KH UAF packages host-readable workflow skills, runtime gates, scoped memory, token telemetry, role orchestration, GoalState, progress state, and quality checks. Its packaged always-on-front-door skill directly requests routing for every new conversation and user task but cannot guarantee host auto-selection or plugin injection; prove actual use with runtime receipts, session audits, and installed cache paths.
